name: R3_sbt_ubt_strips
description: Reference 3 (Guglielmo 16 Nov 2026): R2 (full SBT + UBT) + the V0 rule (candidate traced back as a neutral, any hit within 5 cm + 25 mrad x distance, time window opened 3 ns early) + silicon strips in the MS7 magnet: 5 layers in the 50 cm iron (29.39 .. 29.89 m), evenly spaced from the entrance to 15 cm before the end (29.39, 29.4775, 29.565, 29.6525, 29.74 m), each 3 stations of 20 x 20 cm on the hottest cells of the V0 parents (superimposed on the iron and field).
